content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD mod_foam_upwinding.F: 'upwinding' variant of Module MOD_FOAM (same module name as mod_foam.F, whole file inside # if defined (FOAM), L1/L561). Module data (L11-35) matches mod_foam.F except BurstTimeNonBreaking is absent: BurstRate=0.01_SP (L12), MinThick=0.01_SP (L15), TransferRate=0.1_SP (L16), CdFoam=0.5 (L17), foam arrays EtaFoam/EtaFoamMax/UFoam/VFoam (L19), staged surface arrays and DepthFoam (L20-23), MaskFoam (L25), MxFoam/MyFoam/FxFoam/FyFoam/GxFoam/GyFoam (L26-27), SinkM/SourceM (L28), f_source=0.05 (L29), FoamTimeScale=3.8 (L30), OUT_FOAM=.FALSE. (L32), PARAMETER SMALL=0.000001_SP (L35). ALLOCATE_FOAM (L39-54) allocates cell and face arrays. INITIALIZATION_FOAM (L56-251) reads via READ_FLOAT with defaults and logging: PLOT_INTV_FOAM (L76, default PLOT_INTV L83), BurstRate (L97, USE_BURSTRATE only), f_source (L120), FoamTimeScale (L140), MinThick (L162), TransferRate (L183, USE_BURSTRATE only), CdFoam (L206, default 0.5_SP L208); zero-initializes all arrays, MaskFoam=1 (L228-249). FOAM_UPDATE (L253-338): Usurf=U, Vsurf=V, VFsurf=AGE_breaking (L259-261); old USE_BURSTRATE source/sink (L264-273: VFsurf<0.1 -> 1000, VFsurf=0.4*EXP(-VFsurf) L268-269, SinkM=EtaFoam*BurstRate L270, SourceM=VFsurf*TransferRate*MaskFoam L271); default branch citing Reul and Chapron 2003 (L275-288): age<2*DT resets VFsurf=LARGE and EtaFoamMax=0 (L279-282), EtaFoamMax tracking (L283), SinkM=EtaFoam/FoamTimeScale*EXP(-VFsurf/FoamTimeScale) (L285; EtaFoamMax-based version commented L284), SourceM=f_source*nu_break*MaskFoam (L286). Unlike mod_foam.F, here MxFoam/MyFoam already hold flux DIVERGENCE, so the thickness update is EtaFoam=EtaFoam-DT*MxFoam(I,J)-DT*MyFoam(I,J)-SinkM*DT+SourceM*DT with no /DX (L300-303), clipped non-negative (L305). The Shi et al ICCE 2012 foam momentum (drag) update is entirely commented out (L315-336), so UFoam/VFoam are never advanced in this variant. FOAM_BC (L340-405): zeroes Mxfoam(1,J)/EtaFoam(1,J) west (L349-352), Mxfoam(Mloc1,J)/EtaFoam(Mloc,J) east (L363-366), Myfoam south/north (L377-380, L389-392) on physical boundaries; PARALLEL exchanges only EtaFoam (L398) - UFoam/VFoam exchanges commented out with note 'remove the approach of Shi et al. ICCE' (L399-401). FOAM_FLUX_ICCE (L407-464) preserves the legacy face-flux construction: MUSCL DelxFun/CONSTRUCT_X of EtaFoam then UFoam with upwind selection by face-averaged UFoam sign into MxFoam (L415-436), same in y with VFoam (L439-460). FOAM_FLUX (L466-511), the active version: first-order cell-centered upwind divergence using the water velocity u,v (not UFoam/VFoam): if u(I,J)>ZERO backward difference MxFoam=(u*EtaFoam - u(I-1)*EtaFoam(I-1))/DX else forward difference (L477-489, CARTESIAN scalar vs DX(I,J)); same for MyFoam with v (L493-509). UPDATE_FOAM_MASK (L513-557, 'useless so far') identical wetting/drying mask logic as mod_foam.F (L518-555).
entities: SUBROUTINE INITIALIZATION_FOAM (L56), locals I,J,K (L66), FILE_NAME/TMP_NAME (L68-69), Ifile,ierr (L70)

unresolved: This file declares Module MOD_FOAM (L2) with the same module name as mod_foam.F; which of the two files is compiled into a build is decided by the Makefile, outside this file.

Cross-line: UFoam/VFoam are zero-initialized (L230-231), never updated (momentum block commented L315-336) and their ghost exchanges are commented out (L400-401), yet FOAM_FLUX_ICCE still upwinds on their sign (L419, L430, L443, L454). The active FOAM_FLUX instead uses the water velocity u,v (L477, L495). With UFoam identically zero the ICCE routine would always take the ELSE branch.

Cross-line: the EtaFoam update subtracts DT*MxFoam directly (L300-303) treating MxFoam as a divergence [m/s], while FOAM_FLUX_ICCE fills MxFoam as a face flux [m^2/s] (L420-434); the two flux routines are dimensionally incompatible with the same update line - only FOAM_FLUX (L466) is consistent with L300.
myid is referenced in PARALLEL write branches (L79, L86, L101, ...) but not imported by any USE GLOBAL list in this module (L3-8, L58-60) - same issue as mod_foam.F.

The nonbreaking-zone age handling (BurstTimeNonBreaking) present in mod_foam.F has no counterpart here; VFsurf in never-breaking cells keeps AGE_breaking's value (L261) with no special-case (L275-288).

Unused in this file: CdFoam/MinThick are read (L162-206) but their only consumers (drag update, L320-334) are commented out except MinThick in UPDATE_FOAM_MASK (L524-548); FxFoam/FyFoam/GxFoam/GyFoam, Usurf1/2, Vsurf1/2, VFsurf1/2, DepthFoam only allocated/zeroed; locals Uabs/Uadd/Vadd (L255), VxL/VxR/VyL/VyR/DelX/DelY of FOAM_FLUX (L468-470), left/right/top/bottom (L515).
OUT_FOAM/PLOT_INTV_FOAM/PLOT_COUNT_FOAM set up (L32, L75-90) but no output routine exists in this module.
